list.title: Flows
list.description: A series of actions you run on any of your cities at once.

detail.deleteDescription: Its actions and settings are removed, and a run in progress stops. This cannot be undone.
detail.noArmy: Choose a saved army for the attack (Edit): until then its targets are skipped.
detail.pickFlow: Pick a flow, or create a new one.

cityPicker.label: Cities
cityPicker.allHintSkipped: ({{cities}}, and any you gain later; {{skipped}} with no hero skipped)

flowEditor.description: Actions run top to bottom in each city. A wait pauses the whole flow, every city together. Drag actions (or use the arrows) to reorder.
flowEditor.locked: This flow is running: you can change its settings (targets, amounts, cities), but stop it to add, remove or reorder actions.
flowEditor.name: Name

heal.label: Heal all injured troops with
heal.armiesHome: when the city's armies are home

wait.label: Wait
wait.armiesHome: until the armies sent are home

runFlow.title: Run
runFlow.description: Each city runs the flow all-or-nothing between waits: if an action fails there, what the flow did in that city since the last wait is undone, and the flow stops. Flows take turns between waits, so other flows run while one waits. Preview shows what would happen up to the first wait, without changing anything.
runFlow.repeatHint: Runs again after every run (at most once a minute) on the flow's cities, until a run fails or you switch it off.

toasts.repeatOn: {{name}}: repeats until a run fails or you switch it off

report.undone: What the flow did in this city since the last wait was undone.

statusBadge.held: Held until every hero of its cities is home

statusLine.held: Waiting for every hero of its cities to come home (and for flows held before it), checking again in {{time}}.
